task: 8-node, two-relation, four-instruction composition; distinct paths and different-relation node rereads
hard_mask: exclude previous attention argmax slots; original bank not erased
supervision: final color CE only; reference paths never passed to model or optimizer
program_control_prior: one visible query instruction supplied per transition round; final COLOR opcode after four transitions
trained_read_rounds: four transition reads + one color read; no random-depth training
heads: answer head sees workspace only; no direct bank/history bypass
synthetic_test: labels structurally verified, never used for gate or selection; model evaluation after all main runs
round_encoding_extrapolation: rounds beyond five reuse final trained embedding
coverage_selection: lambda/rho fixed before pilot, no diversity-based tuning
